name: Star Spark
description: Cast Star Spark at Level 2 for 10 Mana. Critical casts leave behind an Astral Charge that empowers your next offensive spell.

narrationTiers.narration: A tiny spark of starlight sputters from your fingertips and reluctantly bumps into your foe. It tried its best.
A bright little star zips through the water, circles your foe once for seemingly no reason, then bonks them directly on the head.
A sparkling star shoots forward with surprising confidence, zigzags dramatically through the water, and smacks your foe in a burst of Astral glitter.

The spark launches like a tiny comet, streaking across the battlefield before bursting against your foe in a shower of stars. That seemed significantly more powerful than something that small had any right to be.

The little star suddenly erupts with Astral energy and slams into your foe. When the light clears, a glowing Astral Charge is stuck directly to the enemy's forehead. They do not look pleased about this.

criticalFlavor: The Astral Charge makes a tiny *ding!* as it attaches itself. Nobody knows why.
Your foe tries to shake the Astral Charge off. It stubbornly remains attached.
The Astral Charge has chosen the forehead. Negotiations have failed.
Your foe stares at the glowing star attached to their forehead. You stare back. This is awkward.
The Astral Charge sparkles triumphantly. Your foe appears personally offended.
